svg.title: The write pipeline
svg.desc: How ohne processes a create call, in order. Inside one transaction: the record:before-change hook may edit the input, which is then frozen. Unknown keys are rejected. Each field, in parallel, is prepared (an omitted field takes your default, the type's, or null, else it is required; an explicit null needs a nullable field; values are coerced), passes its when gate, then is checked: base type, the field type's sanitizers and validators, your own sanitizers and validators, and serialize. The first message stops that field. If any field failed, the transaction still commits, no row is inserted, and the call returns every field error at once. Otherwise record:validate, uniqueness and references run one at a time, then the rows are written, read back and committed, record:committed fires, and the call returns ok: true with the record.
